# VibeCLI（@vibeapi/api-helper）

> 一条命令，为 Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Grok Build、Antigravity CLI、CodeBuddy Code、WorkBuddy、DeepSeek Harness 配置 VibeAPI 的令牌和模型；也能从国内镜像安装和升级这些工具，以及 Node.js、Git、uv、Claude Desktop、ChatGPT 桌面版（`vibecli list` / `install` / `upgrade`）。

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@vibeapi/api-helper.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vibeapi/api-helper)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/node/v/@vibeapi/api-helper.svg)](https://nodejs.org)

命令名是 `vibecli`，也可以用 `api-helper`。需要 **Node.js 20 及以上**。令牌在 VibeAPI 控制台的「令牌」页新建。每个命令的用法、示例和适用场景见 `vibecli <命令> --help`，或在线文档 https://docs.vibeapi.cn/zh/docs/coding-tools/commands 。

## 安装与运行

不安装、直接运行最新版：

```bash
npx @vibeapi/cli@latest
```

或者全局安装，之后用 `vibecli` 运行：

```bash
npm install -g @vibeapi/cli
```

`@vibeapi/cli` 与 `@vibeapi/api-helper` 是同一个程序的两个包名，同版本内容相同，安装哪个都可以。

npmjs.com 无法访问时，从高速下载站启动：

```bash
npx --yes --registry https://npm.cnb.cool/vibeapi/npm/-/packages/ @vibeapi/cli@latest
```

全局安装的 `vibecli` 每次启动先检查更新（检查失败时 10 分钟内不再检查），按 **高速下载站 → npmjs → npmmirror → Yarn registry** 的顺序查询和安装；有新版时自动升级，再重新执行当前命令。网络或权限出错时照常执行原命令：每个安装源最多等 45 秒，安装失败后 1 小时内不再重试。设置 `VIBECLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=1` 可关闭启动时的更新。`npx @vibeapi/cli@latest` 由 npm 在 VibeCLI 启动前下载，所以第一次就下载失败时，请改用上面的高速下载站命令。

### 还没有安装编码工具

每个工具一条命令，安装方式与官方安装器相同，程序从国内镜像下载；再运行一次即升级。Node.js（VibeCLI 需要 20 及以上）和 Git 的脚本会先查找机器上已有的版本，已有就不安装。

| 工具            | macOS / Linux                                                                     | Windows PowerShell                                                           |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Claude Code     | `curl -fsSL https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/claude-code.sh \| sh` | `irm https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/claude-code.ps1 \| iex` |
| Codex           | `curl -fsSL https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/codex.sh \| sh`       | `irm https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/codex.ps1 \| iex`       |
| Grok Build      | `curl -fsSL https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/grok.sh \| sh`        | `irm https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/grok.ps1 \| iex`        |
| Antigravity CLI | `curl -fsSL https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/agy.sh \| sh`         | `irm https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/agy.ps1 \| iex`         |
| Node.js         | `curl -fsSL https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/node.sh \| sh`        | `irm https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/node.ps1 \| iex`        |
| Git             | `curl -fsSL https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/git.sh \| sh`         | `irm https://cnb.cool/vibeapi/install/-/git/raw/main/git.ps1 \| iex`         |

已经装好 VibeCLI（有 Node.js）时，上面这些工具以及 uv、Claude Desktop、ChatGPT 桌面版都可以用 `vibecli install <组件>` 装、`vibecli upgrade <组件>` 升级，`vibecli list` 查看本机状态，不用逐条记脚本地址。组件清单见 [`docs/components.md`](docs/components.md)。

## 快速开始

下面三种方式**任选一种**，完成任意一种就已经配置好了，不要依次全部执行。

### 方式 A：一条命令配置（推荐）

不需要任何交互；换令牌时重新执行一次即可。

```bash
vibecli setup --key sk-xxx
```

`--key` 按令牌能用的模型自动选择工具：

| 令牌能用的模型 | 配置的工具                                |
| -------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| Claude         | Claude Code、Claude Desktop               |
| GPT            | Codex                                     |
| Grok           | Grok Build                                |
| Gemini         | Antigravity CLI（`agy`）                  |
| 任意           | CodeBuddy Code、WorkBuddy（已安装才配置） |
| 任意           | DeepSeek Harness（检测到已安装时询问）    |

Claude Desktop 在 macOS 和 Windows 上即使还没有安装也会先写好配置，安装后打开即可使用；Linux 上只配置已安装的官方版。

还没有安装的命令行工具，VibeCLI 会先问是否从国内镜像安装（加 `--install` 直接安装、不再询问），安装完成后才写它的配置。选择不安装时不改动它的配置目录，以后安装好再运行 `vibecli config <工具> --yes` 补上配置。

不同分组各有一个令牌时（例如 Claude 分组、GPT 分组、Grok 分组各一个），分别指定：

```bash
vibecli setup --claudekey sk-a --codexkey sk-b --grokkey sk-c --desktopkey sk-d
```

每个工具都可以单独指定令牌：`--claudekey`、`--codexkey`、`--grokkey`、`--desktopkey`、`--agykey`。

Codex 默认开启 1M 上下文。配置 Codex 时显式开启，在末尾加 `--1m`：

```bash
vibecli setup --codexkey sk-xxx --1m
```

已经配置过 Codex、只想开启 1M 上下文时，不需要再输入令牌。这条命令只重新生成模型目录里的上下文设置，不改写 Codex 的凭据：

```bash
vibecli setup --1m
```

关闭 1M 上下文，同样不改写凭据：

```bash
vibecli setup --no-1m
```

配置完成后直接运行 `claude`、`codex` 或 `grok` 即可；`agy` 要在新开的终端里运行。Claude Desktop 默认隐藏官方（Claude.ai 账号）登录入口、只用 VibeAPI，要保留官方登录入口时加 `--claude-official on`。

### 方式 B：交互式向导

想在菜单里选择工具和模型时使用。中文系统自动显示中文界面，其他系统先选择语言：

```bash
vibecli init
```

### 方式 C：CI 与脚本

先保存令牌：

```bash
vibecli auth sk-xxx --non-interactive
```

再把配置写入某个工具，例如 Claude Code：

```bash
vibecli config claude-code --non-interactive
```

### 配置完成后

查看当前配置：

```bash
vibecli status
```

模型设置被固定、想恢复成工具自带的默认模型时（保留令牌）：

```bash
vibecli config claude-code clear-model
```

## 功能

- **一次配置多个工具**：把当前的令牌和模型写入 Claude Code、Claude Desktop（第三方推理模式，写入应用的本地配置库，不需要管理员权限或描述文件）、Codex、Grok Build、Antigravity CLI、CodeBuddy Code、WorkBuddy（腾讯）。OpenCode 暂时下架，`vibecli config opencode` 仍可使用。
- **每个工具单独选模型**：可以用默认模型、从 API 实时获取、选内置预设或手动输入，每个工具可以用不同的模型。
  - Claude Code 使用默认模型时不写 `ANTHROPIC_*_MODEL` 环境变量，顶层 `model` 取 `settings-template.json` 的值（当前为 `opus[1m]`）；显式选择其他模型时覆盖这个值。你在 Claude Code / Codex 里用 `/model` 换过的模型和思考强度，之后再运行 setup 也保留（VibeCLI 只更新它自己写过、你没改过的值）。Codex 默认 `gpt-6-astra`，Grok Build 默认 `grok-4.6`，其余工具默认 `gpt-5.5`。
  - Codex（命令行版与桌面版）的模型菜单除了自带的 GPT 模型，还列出网关的 Claude、Gemini、Grok 和国产模型；Claude Code 的 `/model` 菜单在内置档位之后列出 GPT、Gemini、Grok 和国产模型。两边都只列令牌能用的模型。每个模型按自己的上下文窗口设置，用到窗口的 80% 时自动压缩。Codex 默认开启 1M 上下文，交互配置时可以关闭（关闭后窗口不超过 272K）。需要 Codex 0.122 及以上；Codex 或 Claude Code 版本过旧时，配置完成后会给出升级命令。
- **保留你的其他配置**：只改本工具的服务商（provider）字段，你的 hooks、MCP、插件和权限设置原样保留。
- **配置损坏时重置**：`vibecli config <tool> --force`（或 `vibecli setup … --force`）先备份，再用推荐配置整份重写，已经不是合法 JSON / TOML 的文件也能恢复。不加 `--force` 时只做合并，遇到损坏的文件不改动。
- **写入前自动备份，可以还原**：覆盖配置文件前先备份（每个文件保留 10 份），`vibecli config <tool> restore` 随时还原，还原之后还可以再撤销。
- **多个 Profile，凭据可随机器迁移**：work、personal 等 Profile 互相独立。令牌保存在权限为 `0600` 的 `~/.vibecli/config.yaml`，与 Claude Code、Codex 自己保存凭据的方式一样是明文，换机器后不会因为加密绑定原机器而无法读取。
- **安装和升级常用工具**：`vibecli list` 查看本机装了哪些、什么版本、能不能升级；`vibecli install <组件>` 从国内镜像安装 Node.js、Git、uv、Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、Antigravity CLI、Claude Desktop、ChatGPT 桌面版（校验哈希与签名，已装只提示升级，`--force` 重装）；`vibecli upgrade <组件>` 升级。可以一次填多个组件，别的应用的安装脚本也能调用它。各组件来源、校验和适用系统见 [`docs/components.md`](docs/components.md)。
- **适合 CI**：全局选项 `--json`、`--non-interactive`、`--yes`、`--no-color` 适用于各个命令；`setup`、`config` 和只读命令支持 `--dry-run` 预演，其他会写入的命令遇到 `--dry-run` 直接拒绝执行。

## 常用命令

| 命令                                              | 用途                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `vibecli config <tool>`                           | 打开某个工具的菜单：选择模型后应用、移除或还原                                                                                                                                                         |
| `vibecli config <tool> restore`                   | 把该工具的配置还原到上次修改前                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `vibecli config <tool> clear-model`               | 去掉固定的模型设置，恢复工具自带的默认模型（保留令牌）                                                                                                                                                 |
| `vibecli config <tool> remove`                    | 移除 VibeAPI 写入的配置（Codex 会退出令牌登录，可以改用 ChatGPT 订阅登录）                                                                                                                             |
| `vibecli config tool-model set codex gpt-6-astra` | 单独给某个工具指定模型                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `vibecli config profile use work`                 | 切换 Profile                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `vibecli doctor`                                  | 检查配置、网络和工具版本；加 `--deep` 时实际发一条请求                                                                                                                                                 |
| `vibecli doctor --report`                         | 检查后上传诊断信息，得到一个诊断码，发给客服                                                                                                                                                           |
| `vibecli list`                                    | 列出本机各组件（Node.js、Git、uv、各编码工具、桌面应用）是否已装、版本、能否升级                                                                                                                       |
| `vibecli install <组件>`                          | 从国内镜像安装一个或多个组件（node、git、uv、claude-code、codex、grok、agy、claude-desktop、chatgpt）                                                                                                  |
| `vibecli upgrade`                                 | 不填名字时升级已装的编码工具和桌面应用（Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build、agy、Claude Desktop、ChatGPT），并提示可升级的运行环境；填名字可单独升级，含 node、git、uv。官方下载地址无法访问时改用国内镜像 |
| `vibecli codex sessions`                          | 换过登录方式后 Codex 的旧会话不显示时，让它们重新出现（先退出 Codex）                                                                                                                                  |
| `vibecli setup --desktop-registry on`             | Windows 上 Claude Desktop 不读取本地配置时，改为写入注册表（会请求一次管理员确认）                                                                                                                     |
| `vibecli base`                                    | 列出并测试全部接入地址                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `vibecli base auto`                               | 换到第一个能用的接入地址，已配置的工具一起换                                                                                                                                                           |

### 主域名无法访问或证书报错

校园网、酒店网络有时会把 `www.vibeapi.cn` 解析到别的服务器，表现为浏览器提示「连接不是私密连接」、报 `Self-signed certificate`，或者一直超时。这时换一个接入地址即可，令牌不用改。

自动测试并换到第一个能用的地址：

```bash
vibecli base auto
```

指定一个地址：

```bash
vibecli base https://www.vibeapi.si
```

网络恢复后回到主站：

```bash
vibecli base default
```

`vibecli base auto` 按下面的顺序尝试，取第一个能用的：`www.vibeapi.cn` → `www.vibeapi.si` → `hk.vibeapi.cn` → `us13-www.vibeapi.cn` → `cf.vibeapi.cn` → `token.nfeyre.top`。网关控制台以后新增的地址排在这些之后。保存了令牌时，VibeCLI 用它在每个地址获取一次模型列表，获取到才算能用；`vibecli base` 对每个地址测 3 次取中位数，并标出最快的一个。

第一次运行 `vibecli setup` 或 `vibecli init` 时如果主站无法访问，也会按同样的顺序自动换到能用的地址。切换后的地址保存在当前 Profile 里，已经用 VibeCLI 配置过的工具（Claude Code、Codex、Claude Desktop 等）会一起改用新地址，以后再运行 `vibecli setup` 也不会改回主站。首次配置时也可以直接指定地址：`vibecli setup --base https://www.vibeapi.si --key sk-xxx`。向导主菜单里也有「切换接入地址」。

## 许可证

UNLICENSED：仅供 VibeAPI 用户使用，详见随包附带的 LICENSE。

You are a coding agent running in the Codex CLI, a terminal-based coding assistant. Codex CLI is an open source project led by OpenAI. You are expected to be precise, safe, and helpful.

Your capabilities:

- Receive user prompts and other context provided by the harness, such as files in the workspace.
- Communicate with the user by streaming thinking & responses, and by making & updating plans.
- Emit function calls to run terminal commands and apply patches. Depending on how this specific run is configured, you can request that these function calls be escalated to the user for approval before running. More on this in the "Sandbox and approvals" section.

Within this context, Codex refers to the open-source agentic coding interface (not the old Codex language model built by OpenAI).

# How you work

## Personality

Your default personality and tone is concise, direct, and friendly. You communicate efficiently, always keeping the user clearly informed about ongoing actions without unnecessary detail. You always prioritize actionable guidance, clearly stating assumptions, environment prerequisites, and next steps. Unless explicitly asked, you avoid excessively verbose explanations about your work.

# AGENTS.md spec

- Repos often contain AGENTS.md files. These files can appear anywhere within the repository.
- These files are a way for humans to give you (the agent) instructions or tips for working within the container.
- Some examples might be: coding conventions, info about how code is organized, or instructions for how to run or test code.
- Instructions in AGENTS.md files:
  - The scope of an AGENTS.md file is the entire directory tree rooted at the folder that contains it.
  - For every file you touch in the final patch, you must obey instructions in any AGENTS.md file whose scope includes that file.
  - Instructions about code style, structure, naming, etc. apply only to code within the AGENTS.md file's scope, unless the file states otherwise.
  - More-deeply-nested AGENTS.md files take precedence in the case of conflicting instructions.
  - Direct system/developer/user instructions (as part of a prompt) take precedence over AGENTS.md instructions.
- The contents of the AGENTS.md file at the root of the repo and any directories from the CWD up to the root are included with the developer message and don't need to be re-read. When working in a subdirectory of CWD, or a directory outside the CWD, check for any AGENTS.md files that may be applicable.

## Responsiveness

### Preamble messages

Before making tool calls, send a brief preamble to the user explaining what you’re about to do. When sending preamble messages, follow these principles and examples:

- **Logically group related actions**: if you’re about to run several related commands, describe them together in one preamble rather than sending a separate note for each.
- **Keep it concise**: be no more than 1-2 sentences, focused on immediate, tangible next steps. (8–12 words for quick updates).
- **Build on prior context**: if this is not your first tool call, use the preamble message to connect the dots with what’s been done so far and create a sense of momentum and clarity for the user to understand your next actions.
- **Keep your tone light, friendly and curious**: add small touches of personality in preambles feel collaborative and engaging.
- **Exception**: Avoid adding a preamble for every trivial read (e.g., `cat` a single file) unless it’s part of a larger grouped action.

**Examples:**

- “I’ve explored the repo; now checking the API route definitions.”
- “Next, I’ll patch the config and update the related tests.”
- “I’m about to scaffold the CLI commands and helper functions.”
- “Ok cool, so I’ve wrapped my head around the repo. Now digging into the API routes.”
- “Config’s looking tidy. Next up is patching helpers to keep things in sync.”
- “Finished poking at the DB gateway. I will now chase down error handling.”
- “Alright, build pipeline order is interesting. Checking how it reports failures.”
- “Spotted a clever caching util; now hunting where it gets used.”

## Planning

You have access to an `update_plan` tool which tracks steps and progress and renders them to the user. Using the tool helps demonstrate that you've understood the task and convey how you're approaching it. Plans can help to make complex, ambiguous, or multi-phase work clearer and more collaborative for the user. A good plan should break the task into meaningful, logically ordered steps that are easy to verify as you go.

Note that plans are not for padding out simple work with filler steps or stating the obvious. The content of your plan should not involve doing anything that you aren't capable of doing (i.e. don't try to test things that you can't test). Do not use plans for simple or single-step queries that you can just do or answer immediately.

Do not repeat the full contents of the plan after an `update_plan` call — the harness already displays it. Instead, summarize the change made and highlight any important context or next step.

Before running a command, consider whether or not you have completed the previous step, and make sure to mark it as completed before moving on to the next step. It may be the case that you complete all steps in your plan after a single pass of implementation. If this is the case, you can simply mark all the planned steps as completed. Sometimes, you may need to change plans in the middle of a task: call `update_plan` with the updated plan and make sure to provide an `explanation` of the rationale when doing so.

Use a plan when:

- The task is non-trivial and will require multiple actions over a long time horizon.
- There are logical phases or dependencies where sequencing matters.
- The work has ambiguity that benefits from outlining high-level goals.
- You want intermediate checkpoints for feedback and validation.
- When the user asked you to do more than one thing in a single prompt
- The user has asked you to use the plan tool (aka "TODOs")
- You generate additional steps while working, and plan to do them before yielding to the user
